title: East Austin Peace & Safety Concerns
summary:
*   A special public hearing was held to address peace and safety issues affecting East Austin neighborhoods.
*   Concerned residents directly presented their feedback and experiences to city officials during the meeting.
*   The entire session was dedicated to gathering community input on these vital local matters.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
FEBRUARY 27,1997
Mayor Todd called the meeting to order, Councilmember Reynolds temporarily absent.
Public hearing on peace and safety in East Austin. (Councilmembers Daryl Slusher, Jackie
Goodman and Mayor Pro Tern Gus Garcia)
Council heard from concerned neighborhood citizens.
ADJOURNED at 9:15 p.m.
Approved on this the 6th day of March, 1997 on, Mayor Pro Tern Garcia's motion,
Councilmember Goodman's second, 7-0 vote.
